title: Northeastern Uni at Multilingual Counterspeech Generation: Enhancing Counter Speech Generation with LLM Alignment through Direct Preference Optimization
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates and benchmarks the model's ability to generate counterspeech against hate speech targeting religious groups (Islam, Jews). It includes specific qualitative analysis and data points regarding religious theology (e.g., distinguishing extremists from true Islamic teachings) and religious stereotypes.
